wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: EMPTY SCHEDULE, and it is a real zero, not a gap: Form A (page 2) carries no entry on any of its ~40 ruled lines - only faint scanner show-through in no column pattern - and the cover's line 1 reads a plain numeral 0 in ALL THREE columns (LAST, THIS, CUMULATIVE), as does line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate). This candidate raised nothing and self-funded nothing; the whole campaign is the 618.00 filing fee on Form B. Zero rows emitted, 0.00 == cover line 1 == 0.

expenditures.detail: The single Form B row (618.00) equals cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells; the LAST cell is left blank (line 1 and line 2 use an explicit 0 there, line 3 and 4 are left empty - the filer was inconsistent, transcribed verbatim). Form B prints no schedule total.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO page subtotal or schedule total; gates run against the cover. p2: zero rows = cover line 1 (0). p3: one row 618.00 = cover line 3 THIS/CUM 618.00 (exact).
gates.row_count: p2 ink-profile scan across the full ruled width finds no inked entry in any date/name/address/amount cell - the marks it returns are faint show-through at grey levels well below the pen ink, spread over the whole sheet rather than aligned to columns, and a full-page 200 dpi read confirms the schedule is unwritten -> 0 rows, 0 emitted. p3 ink scan of the amount column finds exactly ONE inked band (ypx 230-274) and nothing below -> 1 row, 1 emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 the side has a single row, so first == last: the crop pct 82.00,10.45,15.00,2.00 renders '618.00'; a full-width strip across the same band renders '3-17-2014 | Cache County Clerk | filing fee | 618.00'; the control one row-pitch below (ypx 280-325) renders EMPTY. p2 has no rows to point at.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 is written ONLY in the CUMULATIVE cell, as '- 618.00' (negative). Chain: 0 + 0 + 0 - 618.00 = -618.00 - CLOSES EXACTLY. This is a candidate whose only campaign transaction was the filing fee, paid from personal funds without recording it as a contribution, which is why the ending balance is negative.

escalation_note: 600 dpi full-width crop of the single p3 row; 600 dpi control crop one pitch below (empty); 600 dpi + -normalize crops of the cover anchor block and of the line-3/line-4 pair (needed because the line-4 figure sits only in the CUMULATIVE column and carries a leading minus sign that a 90 dpi contact sheet could have dropped).
notes: index.csv says candidate 'Howell', office 'Assessor'; the cover reads 'Full Name of Candidate: Kathleen C. Howell' and 'Name of Office: Cache County Assessor' - AGREES, county office, in scope. Political Party Republican; Office District blank; report dated 10-10-2014 by the filer and clerk-stamped 'RCVD 10 OCT 2014' (the chunk file's date field 2014-10-28 is the county's posting date, not the form's). The cover's zeros are PLAIN NUMERAL ZEROS, not slashed nil marks, so no zero-glyph ruling was needed. Candidate home address and both phone numbers are printed in the clear on the cover and were discarded at read time.

expenditures.note: date written '3-17-2014' with hyphens and a full four-digit year - cleanly parseable
